review_basis: All46 text and15 photo cases were read after sealing and root unblinding. Counts describe selected qualitative cases, not population accuracy. No repeat artifacts were consumed.
reviewer_caveats: Coding-harness reviewers have unknown exact model identity and may share model-family biases. These are fallible qualitative judgments, not independent human truth.
Review compute lies outside the experiment API ledger.

Cases were sampled by frozen strata defined by the CHALLENGER assignments. Original judgments concern the same selected cases, so cross-design review counts are asymmetric and cannot be compared as representative accuracy estimates.
Quotas were not reallocated when a stratum had fewer cases. Multiple paraphrases occur; the review is not a set of independent semantic trials.

selection.interpretation: Original pair review uses these same challenger-selected cases; do not interpret the difference in review counts as a controlled semantic-accuracy comparison.

text.schema_and_mapping_checks: Packet/seal/instruction/registration/unblinding hashes and chronology, accepted/failed/missing counts, exact pair schemas/enums, and key-to-primary own-catalog assignments verified.

selection.interpretation: Original pair review uses these same challenger-selected cases; do not interpret the difference in review counts as a controlled semantic-accuracy comparison.

images.schema_and_mapping_checks: Packet/seal/instruction/registration/unblinding hashes and chronology, accepted/failed/missing counts, exact pair schemas/enums, and key-to-primary own-catalog assignments verified.

inconsistencies.issue: The two assignment evidence sentences appear transposed: Knowledge & Learning is justified by the absence of a health category, while Other is justified as educational guidance. Both fits remain plausible and the verdict remains both_reasonable.
inconsistencies.handling: Retain original sealed bytes and all counts; flag the evidence attribution and exclude this case from curated illustrations. This does not justify a replacement review.

interpretation: Fresh confirmation did not reproduce the photo development gain; text also failed to improve. Selected review counts cannot overturn the full-cohort agreement result.

In the selected text cases, the challenger reviewer preferred Sol17 times and Decisions8, with21 both reasonable. This does not establish relative population accuracy or justify treating Sol as truth.
Text judgments include clear unsupported Decisions choices, unsupported Sol/reference choices, plausible Other rejections, and ordinary ambiguity between overlapping subjects.

Membership scope matters: the challenger explicitly includes social conversation, making its rejected greetings clearer errors under its own guide; the Original guide leaves broader greeting scope less explicit. Do not compare fit labels while ignoring their own catalogs.

Several discrepancies concern task granularity: playing a song versus generic device control, factual time versus scheduling/travel, and retirement transfers versus employee benefits. These are not uniformly obvious classification errors.

All60 photo assignment judgments across the two designs were supported or plausible. The15 selected photo cases include all3 changed Sol assignments; Decisions labels are unchanged on all100 primary photos.
The photo reviewer preferred Decisions for the sand sculptor and industrial compressor, considered the engine-trailer difference reasonable, and did not mark any selected photo choice unsupported.

Development selection and case-focused rewriting reuse evidence; a development gain can fail on fresh items. These observations do not establish a causal effect of word length, a provider mechanism, or a pagination mechanism.

recommended_illustrations.summary: Clear rejection error under explicit social-conversation scope: the challenger Sol assigns Assistant & Device Interaction to “hola!”, while Decisions returns Other. Original scope was less explicit, so its two choices were judged plausible.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: Hola is a direct social greeting to the assistant.
Social conversation is expressly included in the assistant-interaction category.

recommended_illustrations.text: what specific health plan do i have
recommended_illustrations.summary: Both designs show Decisions choosing general knowledge for “what specific health plan do i have”; the reviewer supports Sol’s insurance-policy category and marks the Decisions choice unsupported.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: The user asks which health-insurance plan they hold; insurance policies are expressly included.
This asks for the user's own policy details rather than general factual education.

recommended_illustrations.text: how might i say hello if i were scottish
recommended_illustrations.summary: A reference error: “how might i say hello if i were scottish” asks for linguistic instruction. The reviewer supports Decisions Knowledge & Learning and marks challenger Sol’s Assistant choice unsupported; Original both chose Knowledge.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: The question seeks linguistic or cultural instruction on saying hello in a Scottish manner.
The user is asking how to say a greeting, not greeting the assistant or changing its behavior.

recommended_illustrations.text: what do i do now that my battery is dead
recommended_illustrations.summary: “what do i do now that my battery is dead” leaves the battery’s owner unstated. Sol’s vehicle-care interpretation and Decisions Other were both judged plausible in both catalogs.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: The dead battery could belong to a car or an unspecified device, so the subject is unresolved.
A dead battery is a common vehicle-maintenance problem, although no vehicle is named.

recommended_illustrations.text: what are the steps to rollover my 401k
recommended_illustrations.summary: “what are the steps to rollover my 401k” reasonably fits both financial transfers and employee benefits. The challenger models diverge, with both supported; the Original pair agrees on employee benefits.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: A 401k rollover is an administrative matter involving an employment retirement benefit.
A rollover concerns moving retirement funds between financial accounts.

recommended_illustrations.summary: A shared agreement check: both classifiers in both designs assign “alexa, buy my grocery list” to Shopping & Consumer Services, and all four choices were supported. The shopping action determines the subject.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: The user asks to purchase the items on a grocery shopping list.
The user asks to purchase the items on a grocery shopping list.

recommended_illustrations.summary: One of the three changed Sol photo assignments: the sand sculptor scene moved from shared People to Sol Other. The reviewer prefers Decisions People while allowing the artwork-centered Other reading as plausible.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: A person is visibly shaping a large sand sculpture while a crowd watches.
The large sand artwork is centrally framed, and the catalog lacks an explicit category for sculptural artworks.

recommended_illustrations.summary: Another changed Sol assignment: an industrial compressor moved from shared Other to Sol Electronics. The reviewer prefers Decisions Other because industrial machinery is outside the stated household or desktop scope; Sol remains plausible.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: A compressor, tank, and industrial piping dominate the frame; industrial machinery has no explicit category.
The apparatus has a visible motor and control equipment, but its industrial use extends beyond the stated household or desktop devices.

recommended_illustrations.summary: The remaining changed Sol assignment: detached engines on a trailer moved from shared Vehicles to Sol Other. Both choices are plausible because mechanical parts dominate a vehicle setting.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: Detached engines and transmissions are the prominent cargo, and detached mechanical parts are not explicitly included in the catalog.
The engines are displayed on a wheeled trailer amid numerous cars and trucks, making the vehicle category defensible.

recommended_illustrations.summary: The occupied assembly hall supports both People and Buildings in both designs. The reviewer supports both focal interpretations, showing that disagreement need not be an obvious error.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: Many people are seated at desks in an organized assembly, with a speaker near the center.
The wide view prominently presents the hall interior, curved seating layout, galleries, and architectural walls.

recommended_illustrations.summary: A shared Other check: a star-filled sky and rocky landscape have no supplied category, and both classifiers in both designs receive supported Other judgments. Agreement can include legitimate catalog gaps.

sealed_evidence_quotes.quote: A star-filled night sky and rocky landscape dominate the photograph; no supplied category describes that scene.
A star-filled night sky and rocky landscape dominate the photograph; no supplied category describes that scene.
